label: Join all finite upstream paths by joining immediate forks under well-foundedness (inference)
rule: Well-founded induction on the common starting node and decomposition of the first upstream steps
meaning: Both initial steps have a common extension by the local premise. Induction at the two immediate suppliers extends the original paths to a single node. The companion locates an unjoinable immediate fork somewhere in any weakly connected well-founded graph with two distinct sources, using classical logic to exhibit a failing instance. A second companion specializes the full chain to actual well-founded grounds, weak connectivity, universal local joining and a supplied actual root.
